qualified_behavior: Evidence-anchored model/human semantic passage-state hypotheses can be normalized without raw prose persistence.
Low-confidence semantic claims remain UNRESOLVED rather than being promoted.
Model claims cannot self-promote to authorial intent, protected-language authority or canon authority.
Text-side diagnostic observations must use the canonical STEP-005 dimension owner.
Reader-experience dimensions are rejected from the text-side semantic provider.
A provider cannot self-certify literary defect, functional harm, purpose miss, objective defect or bounded gain.
A provider cannot authorize revision or named-author imitation, and cannot use a universal prose score.
Reconstructive raw text, excerpts, quotes, candidate text, prompts and embedding payloads are rejected.
